capture_command: Use the MCP server named journal_echo. 1. Call its tool echo_record with arguments {"text": "alpha", "n": 1}. 2. Call echo_record again with arguments {"text": "beta", "n": 2}. 3. Call its tool always_fails exactly once with no arguments. Make the calls one after another. Do not use any other tool and do not run shell commands. Finally reply in one line with the two echo values returned and whether always_fails reported an error.

live_process.meaning: the CLI process outcome; distinct from storage finalization (recording.state) and acquisition extent (acquisition.status): EOF never implies success
